name: com.hengda.frame.updaterx.receiver.X2InstallReceiver
description: UpdateX, shiweibsw's Android update library, declares this private Receiver for Android's package-replaced broadcast. In version 1.0.1 its handler is empty, so it performs no work when that event arrives.
disableEffect: There is no behavior to lose in this version; the app's update features are unaffected.
